explanation: Maintain a rolling base-26 hash for the text window and the pattern. On equal hashes, compare the actual substring to reject collisions; update the window hash by removing its leading character and adding the next.
timeComplexity: O(n+m) expected; O(nm) worst case with repeated hash collisions
spaceComplexity: O(m) temporary substring storage when verifying a hash match
